title: java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException in maybeUpdateMediaTimeHistory method
body:
### [REQUIRED] Issue description

I am playing around with the new PlaybackStatsListener

When setting the keepHistory boolean to false the exception will be fired and app will crash
When setting the keepHistory boolean to true the exception will be fired and app will `not` crash

seems like that keepHistory should be conditioned before calling the add method in`maybeUpdateMediaTimeHistory` since the operation cannot be done on the `Collections.emptyList()`

```
   private void maybeUpdateMediaTimeHistory(long realtimeMs, long mediaTimeMs) {
      if (currentPlaybackState != PlaybackStats.PLAYBACK_STATE_PLAYING) {
        if (mediaTimeMs == C.TIME_UNSET) {
          return;
        }
        if (!mediaTimeHistory.isEmpty()) {
          long previousMediaTimeMs = mediaTimeHistory.get(mediaTimeHistory.size() - 1)[1];
          if (previousMediaTimeMs != mediaTimeMs) {
            mediaTimeHistory.add(new long[] {realtimeMs, previousMediaTimeMs});
          }
        }
      }
      
      mediaTimeHistory.add(
          mediaTimeMs == C.TIME_UNSET
              ? guessMediaTimeBasedOnElapsedRealtime(realtimeMs)
              : new long[] {realtimeMs, mediaTimeMs});
    }
```

##### My Code
